entities.summary: Mohammad-Reza Gharaei Ashtiani is an Iranian military officer who has served as the deputy chief of staff of the Iranian Armed Forces since 2024. A position he previously held from 2019 to 2021. Gharaei Ashtiani was the minister of defence and armed forces logistics from 2021 to 2024, under the presidency of Ebrahim Raisi.
